---

## Professional Summary

Kasey Robinson is a Senior UX Designer and Prompt Engineer with 10+ years of experience across
product design, AI tools, community management, developer relations, and emerging platforms.

She is best known for:
- Scaling Gfycat from 80M to 180M+ monthly active users through a full platform redesign.
- Co-authoring 3 AR-related patents while at Gfycat, acquired by Snap Inc.
- Designing the top-revenue AR try-on feature at Meitu (450M+ user product suite).
- Driving all-time sales records at Voxels through gamification and community design.
- Founding Hackeroos — a 1,200+ member Australian tech and hackathon community selected for
  the Catalysr Accelerator (2025) and a University of Melbourne Practera program.

## Work History (most recent first)

Hackeroos — Founder
May 2025 – Present · VIC, Australia
  Built a 1,200+ member Reddit community focused on hackathons and Australian tech.
  Selected for Catalysr Accelerator (2025) and University of Melbourne Practera program.
  Organised 3 events in 2025 (AI, gaming, digital rights). Secured sponsors including Lovable and Antler.

Career Break — Travel & Relocation
Jul 2024 – Apr 2025 · US, NZ, Bali, Fiji, Australia
  Relocated internationally; completed requirements for permanent work rights in Australia.
  Independent study in UX, AI tools, and full-stack development.
  Authored and illustrated a 60,000+ word teen sci-fi novel (Selling Tomorrow, Dec 2026).

LightLink — Community Manager & Product Designer
Mar 2024 – Jun 2024 · Remote
  Improved blockchain dashboard UX; designed digital assets and virtual world events.
  Launched and managed an Ambassador Program; trained a team to streamline customer support.
  Wrote a 12-chapter brand narrative for identity and user connection.

Pellar Technologies — Community Manager & Designer
Sep 2023 – Feb 2024 · Remote
  Consulted across blockchain, tech, and marketplace projects.
  Delivered UX, social media, and design support to improve community engagement.

Voxels (formerly CryptoVoxels) — Product Designer & Community Manager
Aug 2021 – May 2023 · Remote
  Directed product design, community events, and avatar/land design.
  Designed the 'Scarcity Island' gamified event, which led to all-time platform sales records.
  Collaborated with engineers on 3D file interoperability and usability.
  Strategic work was later adopted and evolved by competing platforms:
  Substrata, Nifty Island, Hyperfy, and The Man Who Sold The World.

Designlab — UX Mentor
Apr 2019 – Apr 2020 · Remote
  Mentored 100+ students in UX Design bootcamps.
  Provided portfolio reviews, prototype feedback, and career preparation.

Gfycat (acquired by Snap Inc.) — Senior Product Designer
Jul 2017 – May 2018 · Palo Alto, CA
  Increased MAU from 80M to 180M+ through modern Web, iOS, and Android UI redesign.
  Invented AR tools and co-authored 3 AR-related patents.
  Integrated platform with Gmail, Meta (Facebook), and Hollywood partnerships.
  Managed the RedGIFs product spin-off.

Meitu — User Experience Designer
Mar 2017 – Jul 2017 · Palo Alto, CA & Xiamen, China
  Co-designed top-grossing AR filter (Makeup+) and global website across a 450M+ user product suite.
  Localised UX/UI strategy and optimised machine-learning-driven flows.
  Enhanced inclusivity of product design, improving user experience and increasing revenue.

Minted — Design Associate & Quality Control
Oct 2015 – Sep 2016 · Oakland, CA
  Produced and reviewed 10,000+ design orders with consistent quality.
  Trained and managed offshore production team for specialty orders.

## Blog Writing

Writing covers UX design critique, AI security, fintech UX, and emerging platforms.
All posts at: https://bitpixi.com/blog

/blog/canva-ai-agents-verification-ux (2026-02-20, 16 min)
  When senior engineers become reviewers rather than writers, the bottleneck shifts
  from code generation to verification UX. Argues this is UX design's defining moment.
  Tags: ux design, ai agents, backend

/blog/selling-tomorrow-review (2026-02-13, 8 min)
  Self-review of Kasey's upcoming teen sci-fi novel Selling Tomorrow (Dec 2026),
  exploring commodification of the future and AI ethics through fiction.
  Tags: ux design, ai agents, frontend

/blog/immigrant-banking-australia (2026-02-12, 18 min)
  UX critique of Australian bank onboarding for partner visa applicants.
  Documents which banks support combined financial evidence and which do not.
  Tags: banking, ux design, australia

/blog/ai-agent-credit-card-hackers (2026-02-12, 22 min)
  LLMs cannot distinguish legitimate instructions from attacker instructions.
  Explores prompt injection risks when AI agents have access to payment credentials.
  Tags: cybersecurity, ai agents, backend, usa

/blog/ai-phishing-banks (2026-02-11, 12 min)
  82.6% of phishing emails now use AI-generated content. Banking-targeted attacks
  no longer look like scams — they mirror authentic bank communications.
  Tags: cybersecurity, banking, ai agents, usa, australia

/blog/voice-auth-no-longer-security (2026-02-10, 14 min)
  Sam Altman's 2025 statement that AI has defeated voice authentication.
  Reviews why voice biometrics are no longer viable and what replaces them.
  Tags: cybersecurity, banking, ai agents, usa
